headline: Approved a new civilian Parking Enforcement position and a pay plan change under the new Teamsters Local 251 contract.
summary: Police Captain Joseph Skahan presented a new civilian Parking Enforcement position. The role will enforce parking violations, with a focus on the stadium and downtown areas. Teamsters Local 251 and the City Water Supply Board agreed to a new contract with increases of 3.25% in year 1, 3.25% in year 2, and 3.5% in year 3.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 11, 2026 meeting, 4-0.
Approved the new Parking Enforcement civilian position, 4-0.
Approved the change to the pay plan for Water Supply Board and Teamsters Local 251 under the new contract, 3-0.

decision_titles: New Teamsters Local 251 contract pay plan
transcript:
Donald R. Grebien
Mayor

CITY OF PAWTUCKET
Pawtucket Municipal Annex
100 Freight Street, Room 204
PAWTUCKET, RHODE ISLAND 02860

# PERSONNEL BOARD MEETING
## Minutes

Tuesday September 1, 2026 - 6:00 P.M.

Meeting called to order at 5:58 PM.

1. Roll Call
   - a. Present- Ken Riley, Joe Shottek, Margaret Wingate, Will Ruggiero
   - b. Absent- Patricia Martinez

2. Public Input Period – None

3. Approve and Accept Minutes of Previous Meeting
   - a. Motion to approve August 11, 2026 minutes made by Joe Shottek, 2nd by Will Ruggiero. Approved 4-0.

4. New Business
   - a. Request to add Police-Civilian position:
     - i. Pawtucket Police Captain Joseph Skahan was present to explain a newly created Parking Enforcement role has the approval of the Pawtucket Police Chief, Pawtucket Finance Director and Pawtucket Director of Administration. The position will be a civilian position and part of Local 3960. The Parking Enforcement role will be assigned a dedicated vehicle and will be responsible for enforcing parking violations within the City with a focus on the stadium and downtown areas. The role will have a rolling 40 hours per week schedule. The ideal candidate will be a retired police officer. Should the role be successful in enforcement and generating revenue, there may be future opportunities for adding additional parking enforcement positions.
       - a. Gregg Anderson to confirm whether an ordnance change is necessary for this position.
     - ii. Motion to approve Parking Enforcement position made by Will Ruggiero, 2nd by Joe Shottek. Approved 4-0.
   - b. Approval of new Teamsters 251 contract and pay plan:
     - i. Teamsters Local 251 and City Water Supply Board agreed to new contract with increases of year 1: 3.25%, year 2: 3.25%, year 3: 3.5%.
     - ii. 3 positions will change pay grades under the new contract.
     - iii. Motion to approve request to change pay plan for Water Supply Board/Teamsters Local 251 made by Will Ruggiero, 2nd by Joseph Shottek. Approved 3-0.

5. Old Business:
   - a) City of Pawtucket Human Resources has audited 600 current and former employees to ensure benefit recipient status is correct.

6. Motion to Adjourn. Motion by Joseph Shottek, 2nd by Will Ruggiero. Approved 4-0.

The next meeting of the Board will be on Monday, October 5, 2026 at 6:00 PM in Room 204 in the City Hall Annex, 100 Freight Street, Pawtucket, RI 02860, entrance at 75 Sabin Street.

The meeting adjourned at 7:16 PM.

[signature]
Ken Riley, Chairman

Date: 10/6/2026
